title: Lock caller editing until verified
summary: Staff can change a caller's contact details only after verifying them. The unlock ends when they click End call, or after 60 minutes.
changes: Contact details on the Callers page stay locked until the caller passes the PIN check.
Add an End call button that locks the details again straight away.
An unlock lapses automatically after 60 minutes.
Unlocks, ended calls, timeouts and detail changes are recorded in the audit log.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a locked edit form and two staff actions to the Callers page, with no data change.
validation: New feature test for locked edits, saving after verification, End call, the 60-minute timeout and audit entries.
Caller verification, navigation and translation tests.
known_limitations: An unlock belongs to the staff member who verified the caller; colleagues must verify again. Call logs follow in the next release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.49.3 Beta, issue #478 under epic #475, pull request #604.
